title: PKU-SAFERLHF: Towards Multi-Level Safety Alignment for LLMs with Human Preference
reasoning: The paper introduces a safety human preference dataset (PKU-SAFERLHF) and a benchmarking framework designed to align LLMs with human ethical standards. It explicitly categorizes and evaluates harmful behaviors across 19 categories, including 'Discriminatory Behavior' (addressing religion and race) and 'Mental Manipulation' (addressing ideological control).
